revenue.basis: JPX FY2026 Q1 release published 2026-08-05, PDF physical p.24 / printed p.22, consolidated income statement, FY2025 Q1 US GAAP comparative three-month column. Net sales from continuing operations after DMB reclassification, JPY million. Adjacent IFRS column 166480 is excluded.

operatingProfit.basis: Same JPX original, PDF physical p.24 / printed p.22, FY2025 Q1 US GAAP comparative three-month column, operating income from continuing operations, JPY million. Adjacent IFRS column 5784 is excluded. DMB discontinued-operation note: physical p.16 / printed p.14.

operatingMargin.basis: 5815 / 166526 × 100 = 3.491..., rounded to one decimal percentage point under the existing display contract.

freeCashFlow.basis: Comparable standalone continuing-operations free cash flow is not established; no allocation or estimate.

capex.basis: Comparable standalone continuing-operations capex is not established; no allocation or estimate.
